info.title: MICROSERVICE-PROD-Create Banking Facilities Utilities Administration-v5-spec
info.description: This API facilitates the management of banking facilities related to utilities administration. It allows users to create and configure various utility services for enhanced client offerings. Typical consumers include banking personnel and utility service managers who are seeking to streamline their operations. By leveraging this API, organizations can efficiently manage facility services, thus improving customer satisfaction and operational efficiency.
